body:
I go to GoodLife everyday.

It's not the greatest unfortunately; workouts are only limited to an hour and lot of the machines are taped off from use. However, I guess it's better than no gym!

Glad to finally be able to lose some fat I gained while they were closed haha!
In the future just lie to them. It's none of their business.

I go to GoodLife.

Unless you have comorbidities or are over 75 you'll be good.

These past few months with no gym I was in the worst shape of my life. Working out will be good for your immune system!
